instruction.text: Select the photo of a train station.

feedback.correct: All train stations in the UK have at least one platform, but some have many more! You need to make sure you are on the correct platform for your train.

feedback.end: We find ticket machines in train stations, and we can use them to buy train tickets. We can also buy train tickets online or from the person at the ticket desk in the station.

feedback.finish: This person is looking at a departure board. A departure board tells you when the train will leave, which platform it is on and where it will stop.

instruction.text: Use this departure board to answer the questions.

atoms.a: Where is this train’s final destination?
What time does the train leave?
Could you get this train to Westhampton?

instruction.text: Here is a train platform. Which side of this yellow line do you think you should stand on while you wait for a train?

feedback.end: You should only cross the yellow line when the train has completely stopped in the station.

instruction.text: Select the open button to learn more.

finish.text: When the train has stopped at your platform, you have to press the open door button to board the train. Unlike on buses, you don’t need to press a stop button to get off - trains stop at every station.
finish.sound: train-door-open When the train has stopped at your platform, you have to press the open door button to board the train. Unlike on buses, you don’t need to press a stop button to get off - trains stop at every station.

instruction.text: Who should you ask if you need help on a train journey?

feedback.correct: The conductor will be wearing a train company uniform and checks tickets on the train. They will also be happy to help if you need anything during your journey.

instruction.text: Decide if these statements are true or false.

atoms.a: Trains are normally much slower than cars or buses.
The departure board gives you information about the trains at the station.
You should stand behind the yellow line while you wait for a train.
You can find the conductor if you need help on your journey.
